capabilities: : Set custom icons and colors for UI elements
: Show default icons for file types
intentEvidence: Set custom icons and colors for files, folders, tabs, ribbon actions, tags, properties, bookmarks, and supported Obsidian UI items.
problem: Users lack granular control over the visual representation of files, folders, and UI elements within the Obsidian interface.

relations.evidence: It is a standalone plugin built on Iconic's icon-management foundation

summary: Nicons customizes icons and colors across the Obsidian interface, allowing users to set custom icons for files, folders, tabs, and properties using bundled or local icon packs.
